se-deep-catalogue-4.localised_description: Macro space distortion and extradimensional travel.

se-interstellar-data.name: se-interstellar-data

se-star-probe.localised_description: Collects data from a star and returns [img=item/se-star-probe-data] Star probe data. Must be launched from a space probe rocket silo that is in close orbit of a star.

se-belt-probe.name: se-belt-probe
se-belt-probe.localised_description: Collects data from an asteroid belt and returns [img=item/se-belt-probe-data] Asteroid belt probe data. Must be launched from a space probe rocket silo that is in an asteroid belt.

accumulator.localised_description: Stores a limited amount of energy when available production exceeds demand, and releases it in the opposite case.

se-spaceship-console.name: se-spaceship-console
se-spaceship-console.localised_description: Use to move a spaceship between planets, moons, orbits, and asteroid fields. Must be contained within spaceship walls/doors, no gaps or holes. Integrity check highlights problems.

se-spaceship-console-alt.name: se-spaceship-console-alt
se-spaceship-console-alt.localised_description: This spaceship console is damaged and cannot be used to control a spaceship.

beacon.name: beacon
beacon.localised_description: 8 module slots at 50% transmission efficiency for a maximum module power of 4. Transmits the effects of modules to nearby friendly entities within 3 tiles. Multiple beacons affecting the same entity will overload it and prevent it from operating. Low power draw.

se-compact-beacon.name: se-compact-beacon
se-compact-beacon.localised_description: 10 module slots at 75% transmission efficiency for a maximum module power of 7.5. Transmits the effects of modules to nearby friendly entities within 2 tiles. Multiple beacons affecting the same entity will overload it and prevent it from operating.

se-compact-beacon-2.name: se-compact-beacon-2
se-compact-beacon-2.localised_description: 10 module slots at 100% transmission efficiency for a maximum module power of 10. Transmits the effects of modules to nearby friendly entities within 2 tiles. Multiple beacons affecting the same entity will overload it and prevent it from operating.

se-wide-beacon.name: se-wide-beacon
se-wide-beacon.localised_description: 15 module slots at 50% transmission efficiency for a maximum module power of 7.5. Transmits the effects of modules to nearby friendly entities within 14 tiles. Multiple beacons affecting the same entity will overload it and prevent it from operating.

se-wide-beacon-2.name: se-wide-beacon-2
se-wide-beacon-2.localised_description: 20 module slots at 50% transmission efficiency for a maximum module power of 10. Transmits the effects of modules to nearby friendly entities within 14 tiles. Multiple beacons affecting the same entity will overload it and prevent it from operating.

boiler.name: boiler
boiler.localised_description: Burns fuel to turn water into steam.

heat-exchanger.name: heat-exchanger
heat-exchanger.localised_description: Uses heat energy to turn water into steam.

se-big-heat-exchanger.name: se-big-heat-exchanger
se-big-heat-exchanger.localised_description: A large heat exchanger designed for high temperatures and high capacity.

se-energy-transmitter-chamber.name: se-energy-transmitter-chamber
se-energy-transmitter-chamber.localised_description: Must be connected to an energy beam emitter. Other chambers can be connected to the end or middle of either side. Energy beam injectors can be connected to the sides only.

burner-turbine.name: burner-turbine
burner-turbine.localised_description: Standalone power generation, simple but inefficient.

cargo-landing-pad.name: cargo-landing-pad
cargo-landing-pad.localised_description: A payload delivery site for rocket launch products and cargo rocket capsules.

arithmetic-combinator.name: arithmetic-combinator
arithmetic-combinator.localised_description: Performs arithmetic operations on circuit network signals.

selector-combinator.name: selector-combinator
selector-combinator.localised_description: Performs sorting operations on circuit network signals.

se-spaceship-console-output.name: se-spaceship-console-output
se-spaceship-console-output.localised_description: Outputs signals relating to the spaceship's current status. See Spaceships in [img=virtual-signal/informatron] Informatron for more information [__CONTROL__informatron__].

se-spaceship-clamp.name: se-spaceship-clamp
se-spaceship-clamp.localised_description: A clamp on a spaceship can anchor to a clamp facing the opposite direction. Counts as bulkhead for spaceship containment.

crash-site-chest-1.name: crash-site-chest-1
crash-site-chest-1.localised_description: A container from the crashed ship. It might contain useful items.

crash-site-chest-2.name: crash-site-chest-2
crash-site-chest-2.localised_description: A container from the crashed ship. It might contain useful items.

se-rocket-launch-pad.name: se-rocket-launch-pad
se-rocket-launch-pad.localised_description: Launches its inventory into space. Can take passengers, enter using __CONTROL__toggle-driving__ near the front door. See Cargo Rockets in [img=virtual-signal/informatron] Informatron for more information [__CONTROL__informatron__]

se-space-capsule.name: se-space-capsule
se-space-capsule.localised_description:
Enter the capsule using __CONTROL__toggle-driving__.
Can be used for personal transport between zones, as an emergency escape pod, or in the construction of a Cargo rocket.

se-space-capsule-scorched.name: se-space-capsule-scorched
se-space-capsule-scorched.localised_description: A damaged version of the Space capsule. Requires refurbishment. Enter the capsule using __CONTROL__toggle-driving__.

se-delivery-cannon-chest.name: se-delivery-cannon-chest
se-delivery-cannon-chest.localised_description: An armoured chest designed to safely catch high velocity falling resources. Requires inventory space to safely catch deliveries.

passive-provider-chest.name: passive-provider-chest
passive-provider-chest.localised_description: Makes its content available to the logistic network.

active-provider-chest.name: active-provider-chest
active-provider-chest.localised_description: Sends its content to the logistic network.

storage-chest.name: storage-chest
storage-chest.localised_description: Long-term storage for the logistic network.

buffer-chest.name: buffer-chest
buffer-chest.localised_description: Requests specified items to be available for personal logistics and automated construction.

requester-chest.name: requester-chest
requester-chest.localised_description: Requests specified items from the logistic network.

se-weapons-cache.name: se-weapons-cache
se-weapons-cache.localised_description: A container from the crashed ship. It might contain useful items.

oil-refinery.name: oil-refinery
oil-refinery.localised_description: Converts crude oil to more useful products.

centrifuge.name: centrifuge
centrifuge.localised_description: Processes various recipes for material enrichment or refinement.

fuel-processor.name: fuel-processor
fuel-processor.localised_description: Process any chemical fuels into processed fuel. Gains 10% energy value and has good vehicle acceleration.

industrial-furnace.name: industrial-furnace
industrial-furnace.localised_description: Can use advanced smelting and metallurgy recipes but not kiln recipes.

equipment-gantry.name: equipment-gantry
equipment-gantry.localised_description: Can insert equipment into an item's equipment grid. Has 3 internal containers for item processing. Put armor or vehicles with grids in the grid item input, and equipment in the equipment item input.

equipment-gantry-remover.name: equipment-gantry-remover
equipment-gantry-remover.localised_description: Removes all equipment from an item's equipment grid. Has 3 internal containers for item processing. Put armor or vehicles with grids in the grid item input.

se-space-astrometrics-laboratory.name: se-space-astrometrics-laboratory
se-space-astrometrics-laboratory.localised_description: Combines, compares, and quantifies different sources of astronomic information.

se-space-decontamination-facility.name: se-space-decontamination-facility
se-space-decontamination-facility.localised_description: Cleans substances for use in sterile environments, and prepares liquids for use in low-pressure conditions.

se-lifesupport-facility.name: se-lifesupport-facility
se-lifesupport-facility.localised_description: Sustaining life in more hostile environments.

se-space-genetics-laboratory.name: se-space-genetics-laboratory
se-space-genetics-laboratory.localised_description: A lab dedicated to genetic sequencing, genetic modification, and genetic printing of cultures.

se-space-growth-facility.name: se-space-growth-facility
se-space-growth-facility.localised_description: Grows biological specimens under a range of controlled conditions that are impossible elsewhere. In addition to standard climate controls, everything from micro-gravity vats to high-G centrifuges are available.

se-space-laser-laboratory.name: se-space-laser-laboratory
se-space-laser-laboratory.localised_description: Experiments with lasers. Eye protection must be worn.

se-space-radiation-laboratory.name: se-space-radiation-laboratory
se-space-radiation-laboratory.localised_description: A relatively safe place to play with radioactive material. Can be used for uranium processing.

se-space-thermodynamics-laboratory.name: se-space-thermodynamics-laboratory
se-space-thermodynamics-laboratory.localised_description: Undertakes processes that involve temperature extremes. Can also perform basic thermal processes, such as smelting and kiln recipes.

se-recycling-facility.name: se-recycling-facility
se-recycling-facility.localised_description: Recycles scrap and other byproducts into resources.

se-space-mechanical-laboratory.name: se-space-mechanical-laboratory
se-space-mechanical-laboratory.localised_description: Provides a range of mechanical processes: Crushing, tearing, shearing, vibration, etc.

se-pulveriser.name: se-pulveriser
se-pulveriser.localised_description: Pulverises and crushes harder minerals and planet core fragments.

se-space-particle-accelerator.name: se-space-particle-accelerator
se-space-particle-accelerator.localised_description: Accelerates particles near to the speed of light.

se-space-particle-collider.name: se-space-particle-collider
se-space-particle-collider.localised_description: Collides high-speed particles and analyses the results.

se-space-material-fabricator.name: se-space-material-fabricator
se-space-material-fabricator.localised_description: Synthesises new materials. A cross between a particle collider and 3d printer.

se-gate-platform-scaffold.name: se-gate-platform-scaffold
se-gate-platform-scaffold.localised_description: Whatever the ring is it won't work. This is a construction site to make some repairs, install a few motors, sensors, control interface, and other addons.

se-space-biochemical-laboratory.name: se-space-biochemical-laboratory
se-space-biochemical-laboratory.localised_description: An advanced chemical lab that specialises in bio-chemistry. Can also perform more basic chemical and oil processing.

se-space-electromagnetics-laboratory.name: se-space-electromagnetics-laboratory
se-space-electromagnetics-laboratory.localised_description: Equipment for intense magnetic field and extremely high voltage applications.

se-space-hypercooler.name: se-space-hypercooler
se-space-hypercooler.localised_description: Performs a heat exchange on thermofluid, making one hotter and the other colder.

se-space-assembling-machine.name: se-space-assembling-machine
se-space-assembling-machine.localised_description: A modified assembling machine that can work in space.

se-space-manufactory.name: se-space-manufactory
se-space-manufactory.localised_description: A giant assembling machine, but can craft more complicated recipes. Only works in space (or spaceships).

se-space-radiator.name: se-space-radiator
se-space-radiator.localised_description: Radiates away excess heat from overheated thermofluid.

se-space-radiator-2.name: se-space-radiator-2
se-space-radiator-2.localised_description: Radiates away excess heat from overheated thermofluid.

se-space-supercomputer-2.name: se-space-supercomputer-2
se-space-supercomputer-2.localised_description: Quantum computing. Improved data manipulation, processing and simulation.

se-space-supercomputer-3.name: se-space-supercomputer-3
se-space-supercomputer-3.localised_description: Adaptive neural net on a quantum computing framework. Improved data manipulation, processing and simulation.

se-space-supercomputer-4.name: se-space-supercomputer-4
se-space-supercomputer-4.localised_description: A nano-engineered semi-organic supercomputer that leverages space warping and higher dimensions for increased processing density and energy transport.

se-space-telescope.name: se-space-telescope
se-space-telescope.localised_description: A sophisticated telescope sensitive to multiple wavelengths around the visible spectrum.

se-space-telescope-xray.name: se-space-telescope-xray
se-space-telescope-xray.localised_description: X-rays are blocked by most atmospheres. This powerful telescope is designed for space where atmosphere is not a problem.

se-space-telescope-gammaray.name: se-space-telescope-gammaray
se-space-telescope-gammaray.localised_description: Gamma rays don't refract so you can't focus them with lenses. This powerful telescope uses mirrors and special detectors instead.

se-space-telescope-microwave.name: se-space-telescope-microwave
se-space-telescope-microwave.localised_description: A huge telescope that detects microwaves and the cosmic microwave background.

se-space-telescope-radio.name: se-space-telescope-radio
se-space-telescope-radio.localised_description: A huge telescope that detects very weak radio waves from distant sources.

se-delivery-cannon.name: se-delivery-cannon
se-delivery-cannon.localised_description: A railgun capable of shooting resources into orbit and beyond. Causes damage if not caught safely, use with caution. 1GJ capacity, 50MW when charging.

se-delivery-cannon-weapon.name: se-delivery-cannon-weapon
se-delivery-cannon-weapon.localised_description: A large railgun capable of shooting ammunitions into orbit and beyond. Use with caution.

se-electric-boiler.name: se-electric-boiler
se-electric-boiler.localised_description: Creates steam from water using electrical energy. The process is 90% energy efficient so you don't gain energy. High temperature steam can be used for energy storage. Low temperature steam can be used for crafting.

se-energy-transmitter-emitter.name: se-energy-transmitter-emitter
se-energy-transmitter-emitter.localised_description: The central building that generates an inter-surface energy beam. Can be used as a weapon or to transfer power to an energy beam receiver. Requires attached energy beam chamber, and connected energy beam injectors. Beam strength is based on the number of injectors.

se-energy-transmitter-injector.name: se-energy-transmitter-injector
se-energy-transmitter-injector.localised_description: Must be attached to an energy beam chamber and connected to an emitter. Injectors have a fixed power draw, each one increases the energy sent giving more heat to a receiver, or increases the speed and damage of the beam weapon.

se-nexus.name: se-nexus
se-nexus.localised_description:
Only functions on a moving spaceship, energy use is proportional to speed. Can gain data from interstellar movement, data generation is based on ship kinetic energy. The Nexus is a designed to act as a distortion drive and with the right technology can enable escape from the local stellar cluster.
Applies 2000 container integrity stress.

se-space-elevator.name: se-space-elevator
se-space-elevator.localised_description: Can take wires and trains between a planet or moon's surface and its orbit. See Space Elevators in [img=virtual-signal/informatron] Informatron for more information [__CONTROL__informatron__]

rocket-silo.name: rocket-silo
rocket-silo.localised_description: Launch a satellite into space to unlock the "Navigation Satellite Uplink". More satellites can be sent to discover new planets, moons, and asteroid belts in the star system the satellite is launched from. Can discover new stars once the current system is fully scanned.

se-space-probe-rocket-silo.name: se-space-probe-rocket-silo
se-space-probe-rocket-silo.localised_description: A rocket silo for launching space probes.

stone-furnace.name: stone-furnace
stone-furnace.localised_description: Can use smelting and kiln recipes.

electric-furnace.name: electric-furnace
electric-furnace.localised_description: Can use smelting and kiln recipes.

steel-furnace.name: steel-furnace
steel-furnace.localised_description: Can use smelting and kiln recipes.

se-condenser-turbine.name: se-condenser-turbine
se-condenser-turbine.localised_description: 75% the energy efficiency of a steam turbine but 99% of the steam used is returned as water. Temperature range: 100 to 999.

se-spaceship-rocket-engine.name: se-spaceship-rocket-engine
se-spaceship-rocket-engine.localised_description: Burns liquid rocket fuel. Counts as bulkhead for spaceship containment.

se-spaceship-ion-engine.name: se-spaceship-ion-engine
se-spaceship-ion-engine.localised_description: Uses a small amount of ion stream but lots of power for propulsion. Counts as bulkhead for spaceship containment.

se-spaceship-antimatter-engine.name: se-spaceship-antimatter-engine
se-spaceship-antimatter-engine.localised_description: Annihilates an antimatter stream. Counts as bulkhead for spaceship containment.

se-big-turbine.name: se-big-turbine
se-big-turbine.localised_description: A large generator that takes in 5000°C steam, outputs 500°C steam at the other end, and outputs water at the sides. 2% of input energy is unused and contained in the output steam.

se-dimensional-anchor.name: se-dimensional-anchor
se-dimensional-anchor.localised_description: Uses a star's gravity well as a stabilizing point for a spatial anomaly.

se-energy-beam-defence.name: se-energy-beam-defence
se-energy-beam-defence.localised_description: Energy beam defence facility. Defends against space-based energy beams and coronal mass ejections. The only requirement to function is energy, the base draw is 10MW but increases based on the strength of attacking beams. Only 1 is needed per planet and orbit against Coronal mass ejections, against energy beams weapons 1 Umbrella can defend against up to 500GW of attacking power. See Energy Beams in [img=virtual-signal/informatron] Informatron for more information [__CONTROL__informatron__]

se-addon-power-pole.name: se-addon-power-pole
se-addon-power-pole.localised_description: A small electric pole designed to be attached to buildings or for precise control over electrical coverage.

se-pylon.name: se-pylon
se-pylon.localised_description: Distributes electrical energy. 64 tile connection range.

se-pylon-substation.name: se-pylon-substation
se-pylon-substation.localised_description: Distributes electrical energy. 64 tile connection range, 64x64 power supply area.

se-pylon-construction.name: se-pylon-construction
se-pylon-construction.localised_description: Distributes electrical energy and extends construction area. 64 tile connection range, 64x64 construction area.

se-pylon-construction-radar.name: se-pylon-construction-radar

-- SE sim: ground_runway
    local logo = game.surfaces.nauvis.find_entities_filtered{name = "se-space-exploration-logo-shattered-15tiles", limit = 1}[1]
    game.simulation.camera_position = {logo.position.x, logo.position.y+10.50}
    local zoom = 1
    game.simulation.camera_zoom = zoom
    game.tick_paused = false
    game.surfaces.nauvis.daytime = 0.5

    game.forces.player.bulk_inserter_capacity_bonus = 11

    local start_tick = game.tick
    local final_zoom_speed = 0.0002

    local startup_start = 20*60
    local startup_end = 25*60
    local slowdown_start = 61.65*60
    local slowdown_end = 66.65*60

    local startup2_start = 95*60
    local startup2_end = 100*60
    local slowdown2_start = 136.65*60
    local slowdown2_end = 141.65*60

    script.on_nth_tick(1, function()
      local ticks_since_start = game.tick - start_tick

      -- Zoom out
      if startup_start <= ticks_since_start and ticks_since_start <= slowdown_end then
        if ticks_since_start <= startup_end then
          zoom = zoom - final_zoom_speed * (ticks_since_start - startup_start) / (startup_end - startup_start)
        elseif ticks_since_start <= slowdown_start then
          zoom = zoom - final_zoom_speed
        elseif ticks_since_start < slowdown_end then
          zoom = zoom - final_zoom_speed * (slowdown_end - ticks_since_start) / (slowdown_end - slowdown_start)
        else
          zoom = 0.5
        end
        
        game.simulation.camera_zoom = zoom

      -- Zoom back
      elseif startup2_start <= ticks_since_start and ticks_since_start <= slowdown2_end then
        if ticks_since_start <= startup2_end then
          zoom = zoom + final_zoom_speed * (ticks_since_start - startup2_start) / (startup2_end - startup2_start)
        elseif ticks_since_start <= slowdown2_start then
          zoom = zoom + final_zoom_speed
        elseif ticks_since_start < slowdown2_end then
          zoom = zoom + final_zoom_speed * (slowdown2_end - ticks_since_start) / (slowdown2_end - slowdown2_start)
        else
          zoom = 1
        end
        
        game.simulation.camera_zoom = zoom
      end
    end)
      local mod_gui = require("__core__/lualib/mod-gui")
    if script.level.is_simulation then

      frame.parent.visible = false
    end
